search.website_text:
![GitHub Downloads (all assets, all releases)](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/rail2025/WDIGViewer/total?label=Warriors%20of%20Light%20that%20now%20know%20where%20to%20go%3A%20&color=brown)
open with /wdig
Auto loads current savage tier when you launch the viewer, as well as Occult Crescent!
Installing
Enter /xlsettings in the chat window and go to the Experimental tab in the opening window.
Skip below the DevPlugins section to the Custom Plugin Repositories section.
Copy and paste the repo.json link into the first free text input field.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rail2025/WDIGViewer/main/repo.json
Click on the + button and make sure the checkmark beside the new field is set afterwards.
Click on the Save-icon in the bottom right.
Enter /xlplugins in the chat window and look for WDIGViewer and install.
then select which strategy/folder to open:
![mainwdigscreen](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bdd4ee7b-3be2-4e75-938b-535c8664d937)


![tab select](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/095b7bcb-d0e0-4ccc-afa0-4025001ed8f6)


![trolling](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3fdb0715-97fc-4eaf-891a-8698166e7892)
whiteboard plugin is here:
https://github.com/rail2025/AetherDraw

![no phases](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/71f87b25-0793-4838-924c-b03a7b4907f6)
add your own files, link to the folder with the images in the format of
C:\YOUR_CHOSEN_DIRECTORY\PluginImages\FIGHT_OR_STRAT_NAME\PHASE\IMAGE_FILE.
for example if you have some files like
C:\YOUR_CHOSEN_DIRECTORY\PluginImages\UCOB\P1\GarudaBaits.jpg, C:\YOUR_CHOSEN_DIRECTORY\PluginImages\UCOB\P2\IfritDash.jpg,
you would point the directory to C:\YOUR_CHOSEN_DIRECTORY\PluginImages\
store in PluginImages, rename the fight to whatever you want. shows in alphanumerical file name order, so rename image files accordingly.
WTFDIGViewer will also attempt to auto load baseed on the zone/duty you are in and the folder name, so if you use the official name of the duty/area, or at least as close as possible, it will load the folder correctly.
IMPORTANT!!
reload after addiing images with /wdig reload, hit the rescan button




Occult Crescent images sorted into folders
![directory](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fa5dcc8d-839b-4195-ab0c-5bfb340d3b5c)
![questtips](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f5b273d6-ac2e-400a-ae5e-738d8f35a691) open with /wdig
